bio: When Zzecezalilix's prized pearl was stolen, it could not let such indignity stand. The voidsquid surged up from its trench and stole the captain of a nearby ship to be its vessel on land – to exact justice. It was impossible for its new body to say its old name, so it called itself Cezal. It thinks its disguise is perfect – its poor crew are too terrified to question their new 'captain'.
